title: Don't even hesitate, get one!
text: Don't even hesitate, get one!. I looked up reviews and comparisons before settling on this mini beast of a processor. It's amazing! You only have one button to push and no settings, so everything is a matter of how long you pulse it for to determine minced/grated or mush (for sauces). So far I have not had any issues in getting the produce how I want it, but just realize there's no slicing option on this bad boy and food bits are rather small.  I do appreciate that the entire top is the activate switch so it just takes a little pressure, and that the device is smaller/lighter than a cumbersome food processor and hardly takes up much space at all.

product_metadata.title: ANKII Mini Food Processor 400-Watt Electric Food Chopper for Meats, Vegetables, Nuts, Fruits, Small Mincer Mixer with 4 Stainless Steel Blades, 2 Cup Capacity
features: ✿SAVING YOUR TIME - Mini food chopper assists you easily chop vegetables, meat, fruits, crush ice cubes so on with 4-piece sharp stainless steel blades. Save prep time for your daily meals and allow you have more spare time.

✿EASY TO USE - The top cover is a power push button switch, press it the machine will start working, it will stop working when you release your hand. You can master food proceeding status effortlessly from its solid and transparent container cup.

✿MULTIFUNCTIONAL PROCESSOR - The small food chopper can be used for chopping meat, fish, vegetables, cheese, nuts, fruits or making salad, guacamole and baby food, etc. In order to protect the food chopper, each working time should be no more than 15 seconds. Stop at 5 seconds and continue working.

✿EASY TO CLEAN - Clean with a damp sponge and cloth and wipe dry. The cover, bowl, and the chopping blades can be also cleaned in the upper basket of the dishwasher. This food chopper has a self - locking device. Pls insert blade components before adding foods to avoid machine damage.
✿IDEAL GIFT - Make a difference and offer this exquisite kitchen tool as a unique, practical and easy-to-use gift. It can chop different ingredients to provide the desired vitamin combination.
